issuer.summary: Mento USDm is backed by a shared on-chain reserve across Celo, Monad and Ethereum custody. Reserve assets include other issuers’ stablecoins, EUR assets, sUSDS and volatile collateral. On-chain custody does not remove issuer, bridge, FX or administrator risk. USDm holders have no established direct legal claim on individual reserve assets.
issuer.summary_source: riskAnalyst assets/usdm.md, refreshed 2026-10-17; legal observations retain their prior verification dates.
facts: Issuer is Mento Labs, a German company spun out of Celo's core developer in 2022. Chief executive is doxxed; the company raised a $10M Series A in October 2024.
✅ NO OFF-CHAIN CUSTODIAN. Reserve assets sit in an on-chain reserve contract directly, so the holdings are independently observable rather than attested.
⚠️ LEGAL WRAPPER IS AN ORDINARY COMPANY. No fund structure, no bankruptcy-remoteness — holders have NO DIRECT LEGAL CLAIM on the reserve assets.

⚠️ NOT the same asset as similarly-tickered dollar tokens from other issuers — this is the Celo/Monad deployment, and confusing it with a Treasury-backed namesake would misstate both the backing and the issuer.
Admin Safe observed on Celo and Monad at 4-of-6 on 2026-10-17. Reserve spending and upgrade authority have undelayed paths; the Celo governance timelock does not protect every path.
Monad ReserveV2-only composition on 2026-10-17: 57.28% AUSD, 24.33% USDT0, 18.40% USDC. This is not the full shared reserve or its LP collateral.
